hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Large vans and trucks parked along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbsides

hazards.name: Lack of protected crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signals visible, forcing pedestrians to cross the wide road unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway stretch

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Furniture and merchandise are placed across the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to navigate around them or potentially step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in front of the 'Jinxed' store.

hazards.name: Frequent Vehicle Conflict Points
hazards.description: Large roll-up garage doors indicate frequent vehicle crossings over the sidewalk without clear markings or warnings for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: The two large openings on the building facade.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk is very narrow, providing little buffer from the adjacent travel lane and parked cars.
hazards.location_in_image: The paved area between the building and the curb.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and loading trucks block sightlines between pedestrians and moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs, particularly the left side where loading is occurring.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Encroachment
hazards.description: Vehicles parked perpendicular to the buildings obstruct the narrow pedestrian walkway, forcing people closer to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side of the street in front of the Animal Hospital and YD Home

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer (trees, bollards, or furniture zone) between the narrow sidewalk and high-speed vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side curb line

hazards.name: Lack of midblock crossings
hazards.description: Pedestrians must walk long distances to reach a signalized intersection or risk crossing multiple lanes of traffic mid-block without protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible block

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides

hazards.name: Wide unprotected crossing
hazards.description: The four-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance without any marked crosswalks or refuge islands.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Substandard Sidewalk Width
hazards.description: The sidewalk is significantly narrower than standard accessibility requirements, making it difficult for two people to pass or for mobility device users to navigate.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, along the building frontage

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who might attempt to cross the street.
hazards.location_in_image: White SUV parked at the curb

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway without a median or refuge island increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire roadway width

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can block the view of pedestrians for oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street where cars are parked

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked truck
hazards.description: A large white box truck parked at the curb significantly blocks the line of sight between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, parked along the curb.

hazards.name: Lack of protected crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide road without designated protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire roadway in the foreground.

interventions.title: Construct Raised Sidewalks
interventions.description: Establish a dedicated and protected space for pedestrians separated from the roadway by a curb.

interventions.title: Install Street Trees and Furniture
interventions.description: Create a buffer zone between the new sidewalk and the travel lanes to improve safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Marked Crossings
interventions.description: Reduce the crossing distance and slow traffic by narrowing the roadway at key points.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated walking path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Build out the curb at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or textured paving across the driveway to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way to drivers.

interventions.title: Audible and Visual Exit Warnings
interventions.description: Install sensors that trigger flashing lights or sounds when a vehicle is exiting the garage to alert pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone with street trees to provide a physical and psychological barrier between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossings
interventions.description: Introduce high-visibility marked crosswalks with pedestrian-activated signals to provide safe crossing opportunities on this long block.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a raised, paved sidewalk with a curb to provide a dedicated and protected path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Delineated Loading Zone
interventions.description: Use bollards or pavement markings to clearly separate the industrial loading area from the pedestrian travel path.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reconfiguring the roadway to fewer lanes can reduce vehicle speeds and provide space for wider sidewalks or bike lanes.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting trees along the curb would provide a physical buffer from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Management
interventions.description: Consolidate and narrow driveways to reduce the number of conflict points and improve walkway continuity.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to designate safe crossing points and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalk to provide a clear walking path and a buffer from traffic, potentially by repurposing on-street parking space.

interventions.title: Clear Path Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure a minimum clear width on the sidewalk by regulating the placement of commercial merchandise.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Visibility Improvements
interventions.description: Remove parking near the garage entrances to improve sightlines between exiting vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to keep the sidewalk clear of commercial storage and loading activities to maintain a continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crossing with curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer and narrow the perceived width of the street, which naturally encourages slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Relocate Utilities and Add Buffer
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone or planting strip to clear the sidewalk path and provide a better buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding or Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or underground the lines to clear the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Curb Extension
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to create a furniture zone for utilities and provide a buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.
